Overview

Belo Horizonte is a city in MG with a population of 2,530,701. Minas Gerais’ cosmopolitan capital, a culinary capital famous for its pão de queijo, bar culture, and surrounding mountain landscapes. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
